title: Solution Architect & Lead SE Engineer
description: End-to-End Solution Architecture: Design production-ready AI video-analytics solutions integrating AI models, backend services, and infrastructure. Video Streaming Pipelines: Architect video ingestion using RTSP, ONVIF, and other streaming protocols. Cloud & Edge Infrastructure: Design scalable AWS/Azure/GCP and edge architectures, including GPU infrastructure and edge-device planning. Microservices & APIs: Build secure, highly available, and scalable distributed systems using REST, gRPC, and microservices. AI Model Integration: Lead the integration of AI models into enterprise applications and production environments. Presales & Client Engagement: Translate client requirements into technical solutions, architecture designs, and solution proposals. Technical Leadership & Experience: Lead, mentor, and review engineering teams; require 12–18 years of software engineering experience with strong architecture and technical leadership expertise.
